items.heading: Plan Tax Residency, Bank Account
items.text: Plan Tax Residency, Bank Account Plan tax residency, bank account conversion, and shipping as their own checklist stage in the months before you land, not as something to figure out once you arrive.

items.heading: If You Are
items.text: If you are on an F-1 visa in the US, your OPT status is the single biggest lever on when you can actually leave without burning a job offer or a legal deadline. Get this sequence wrong and the visa clock, not your own judgment, ends up deciding your return date.

items.heading: A Job Search Built
items.text: A job search built for US campus recruiting and a job search built for the Indian market are not the same search. Running only the first one and expecting India offers to appear once you land is the most common reason people spend an extra unplanned month or two unemployed after arriving.

items.heading: File for Opt Before
items.text: File for OPT before you leave the country even if you are certain you are returning, or you lose eligibility permanently.

items.heading: The Bigger Goal Behind All
items.text: The bigger goal behind all of this planning: a well-timed return converts your abroad degree into a real high-income skill portfolio in the Indian market, instead of losing months of income to an avoidable gap.

items.heading: If a Loan Is Still
items.text: If a loan is still running, model the EMI against India take-home pay before fixing the return date. A foreign salary converted into rupees is not the same as a sustainable repayment plan after taxes and living costs.
